_comment: Six-observable reconciliation target set for EUROFER97, 330 C, 15 dpa,
neutron.  Kept SEPARATE from targets.json because that file's condition is
the broad 'EUROFER97 neutron, T <= 400 C' envelope; these are point values
at one condition and would change the meaning of the campaign scorer.
docs/Database/Void.xlsx by filtering Material~Eurofer, T=330 C, dose=15 dpa,
neutron.  Loops: 4 paired rows; voids: 3 rows.
THE CHARACTER FRACTION IS NOT AN INDEPENDENT TARGET.  f_100 =
N_100/(N_100+N_111), so hitting N_100 and N_111 delivers it automatically:
4.97e21/(4.97e21+1.93e21) = 0.72, which is the measured value.  This is why
f_100 is listed as derived, not fitted.
Three of the four loop rows form a self-consistent high-f_100 cluster
N_111 = 1.1e22) is the outlier that widens every range below; 'target' is
taken from the high-f cluster, 'lo'/'hi' span ALL rows.

N_loops_100.note: high-f cluster 4.97/4.67/8.83e21; outlier row 9.0e21 at f_100=45%

N_loops_111.note: high-f cluster 1.93/1.73/3.27e21; outlier 1.1e22 at f_100=45%. Supersedes the null in targets.json.  CEILING RAISED 1.1e22 -> 1.5e22 on 2026-08-19 by the author's decision, as an accepted tolerance rather than a new measurement: the campaign's best vector (i_mobile=5, S1700) sits at 1.43e22, and the ceiling itself is already an OUTLIER row at f_100=45%, not the high-f cluster the rest of the range is built from. Rescoring consequence: rows between 1.1e22 and 1.5e22 now count as in range, campaign-wide and retroactively.

d_111_nm.note: loops are reported at a COMMON diameter per row (d_111 = d_100), so this range mirrors d_100. Supersedes the null in targets.json.

f_100_tem_1.note: DERIVED from N_100 and N_111, not fitted independently.
